## Which layer this belongs in

- [ ] a route (`routes/routes.json` + prompt)
- [ ] an adapter (observation or memory source)
- [ ] the loop itself (state, evaluation, stop rules)
- [ ] docs or examples

Atlas Core keeps the core small on purpose: MQ, GitHub, Obsidian, and model
providers are adapters. If a proposal needs a change to the loop contract, say
what it would break.
